title: A calmer, clearer jury experience
body: The jury intro now plays as a clear card deal and flip sequence that stays on screen, is labeled as a demo, and never returns mid-session. Your score card pops as a large white jury card with precise half-point steps. After confirming, your card joins the panel first, the panel flips in cascade with names, and you get a longer readable hold with Keep-results. Comments expand in place without covering Confirm, and video controls calm down during playback.
